headline: On October 20, 2018: BepiColombo launched to study Mercury
captionCards: BepiColombo's 7-year journey includes multiple planetary flybys
Mission to study Mercury's magnetic field and surface structure
instagramCaption:
BepiColombo embarks on a mission to Mercury. \\[BepiColombo, a joint mission by ESA and JAXA, was launched on an Ariane 5 rocket from French Guiana. The spacecraft carries two orbiters: the Mercury Planetary Orbiter (MPO) and Mio, which will study Mercury's magnetic field, magnetosphere, and surface. This mission is one of the most complex in history, with a seven-year journey involving multiple flybys. \\Why it matters: BepiColombo aims to unlock the mysteries of Mercury's composition and evolution. \\What do you think we'll learn about Mercury? \\Follow @onthisday.reels for daily history ⏳
